evidence_scope: REA 6.4.0 CLI with the Ghidra 12.1.4 provider (OpenJDK 21) against the arm64 slice of the installed DoubaoIme main executable. Static analysis only; the app was not launched.
method: The executable is stripped (no LC_FUNCTION_STARTS, no local symbols). Ghidra recovered Swift stored-property offset symbols (DoubaoImeInputController::*_) and Objective-C selectors.
Swift large string literals are referenced as (count, address - 0x20 | 0x8000000000000000); REA trace_feature and xrefs returned no references for the literal or the encoded address.

Code sites were located with a local ADRP+ADD scan of __TEXT,__text for the encoded literal addresses, and candidate function entries came from __unwind_info. Consecutive functions with identical unwind encodings are merged there, so entries are candidates; a decompiled body was accepted only when it contains the literal.
Literal text was decoded from the shipped bytes at encoded address + 0x20.

literals: [ASR][FinalCommit] skip pasteboard handoff, reason=changedAfterPaste, trigger=smartOrganizeUndoCopy, seq=
observations.observed: With a restore snapshot and a recorded written change count, the function increments the restore token, cancels and clears the scheduled restore DispatchWorkItem, then compares NSPasteboard.generalPasteboard.changeCount with the recorded count: equal logs a handoff, different logs a skip with reason changedAfterPaste.

Before posting Command-V the delayed paste proceeds only if the session is unchanged, asrFinalGeneration_ equals the captured generation, a paste is in flight, Command-V has not been posted, asrFinalTextWriteCount_ is zero and asrPasteCommitSeq_ equals the captured sequence; otherwise it logs staleBeforeCommandV. When the host bundle identifier equals com.microsoft.Excel and NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons is non-zero, the commit waits for mouse release. Named failure reasons cover target change before post, pasteboard change during write and pasteboard write failures; a posted paste is logged with hostAck=unknown.

A host commit resolution with the values hostCommitted, imeCommitRequired, ambiguous and contextInvalid is evaluated before delivery; resolutions that are not hostCommitted return early. On the path that logs strategy skipSystemCommitted with zero writes (reason hostCommittedOriginal), the function increments asrFinalGeneration_, resets asrFinalTextWriteCount_ and stores 2 in asrFinalCommitStrategy_. It also reads a host text-implementation classification (asrAXInputImplementation_) whose inline names include web and qt.

longPressUsesFn is true when the long-press key code is 0x3F (kVK_Function) or when a modifier-only shortcut's generic flags equal 0x800000 (NSEventModifierFlagFunction). shared is true when the long-press and single-click profiles have the same key.

trace_feature found the literals but no references; xrefs at the encoded literal addresses returned empty lists. This is a reference-recovery limit for Swift literals, not evidence that the strings are unused.
ASRTextDisplayWindowController::applyDiff is an import from OimeCommon.framework; the main executable holds only its stubs. OimeCommon was not decompiled.

unresolved: The direct (insertText) versus paste routing condition: its sites lie in a function whose entry was not isolated.
Hold-to-talk event capture (event tap versus NSEvent monitor) and the long-press threshold.
Whether the stale offline-model callback guard changes routing; its candidate entry did not contain the literal.
OimeCommon, OimeEngine and other frameworks; runtime ordering; actual host behavior.
reproduction: Full REA records and the scan scripts are retained in ignored .workspace/research/doubao-rea/. Re-run with GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR set to Ghidra 12.1.x, JDK 21 on PATH and REA_GHIDRA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS raised (default auto-analysis of this slice exceeds the 330 s default).
